title: Canada to host foreign ministers from Lebanon and Austria
excerpt: Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand will meet with Youssef Raggi and Beate Meinl-Reisinger on November 6, 2026.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced on November 4, 2026, that the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Anita Anand, will host the foreign ministers of Lebanon and Austria in Canada on November 6, 2026. These visits are intended to advance bilateral cooperation and strengthen Canada’s ties with Lebanon and Austria.

Minister Anand and Youssef Raggi, Lebanon’s Minister of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants, will discuss opportunities to strengthen cooperation, including through Canada’s continued support for the Lebanese Armed Forces and other state institutions. They will also discuss efforts to support Lebanon’s long-term stability and sovereignty.

Minister Anand and Beate Meinl-Reisinger, Austria’s Federal Minister for European and International Affairs, will exchange views on deepening Canada-Austria cooperation on European and transatlantic security, including continued support for Ukraine. They will also discuss close cooperation during Austria’s upcoming United Nations Security Council term, advance Canada-EU cooperation, and strengthen economic resilience, as well as bilateral trade, investment and innovation ties.

Merchandise trade between Canada and Austria reached $3.6 billion in 2025. Since May 2025, Canada has provided more than $83 million in humanitarian assistance to Lebanon.
